items.title: Google Warns LLMjacking Attacks Are Costing Some Enterprises Up to $1 Million in Cloud Charges

learn.explainer: Root privileges are high-level system permissions that can allow commands to control or change a device. The Barracuda warning says its vulnerabilities could let attackers run commands with these privileges.
A laser weapon uses a concentrated beam of light as a weapon. The item describes Germany developing one for combat aircraft, with the intended ability to shoot down drones and missiles.
Soft power is influence that does not rely only on force. In this item, religious soft power refers to religion's role in statecraft and international politics.

analysis.headline: Security, capability, and influence across domains
paragraphs: The stories span cyber attribution, military technology, and geopolitical influence. US agencies and cyber analysts blame North Korea for the Binance heist, while North Korea denies responsibility. Germany’s planned airborne laser and the account of religion as statecraft point to different forms of power and competition.

For defenders, the Barracuda warning is the clearest immediate action: two flaws could enable root-level commands, and the company urges customers to patch. The SOC forecast also suggests changing roles as AI agents handle routine alerts. Together, they make careful vulnerability management and sound detection work relevant alongside automation.

For analysts, the mix cautions against treating technical capability, responsibility, or influence as settled from a single report. The laser initiative is described as a future aim, while the religion article challenges an assumption about international politics. Watch for how claims are attributed, what capabilities are actually described, and where uncertainty remains.
takeaways: Patch the Barracuda flaws that may enable root-level commands.
Treat the Binance attribution and denial as competing claims.
Track the distinction between planned capabilities and demonstrated ones.
